- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (high sentiment > 0.6) — reduce forecast by 1–3% for 30d horizon.
- Underestimate after sharp price spikes (e.g., >85) — add 2–5% buffer to forecast for next 7–14 days.
- Lagged mean reversion: if 18-day history shows downward trend, forecast should not overshoot above 10% above recent high.
- Overshoot correction: if forecast > true outcome by >5% for 3 consecutive days, reduce next forecast by 2–4%.
- Sentiment-driven bias: if sentiment > 0.7, forecast tends to be 2–4% too high — apply downward adjustment.
- Horizon-specific: 30d forecasts often overreact to short-term sentiment — dampen by 1–3% if sentiment is volatile or >0.7.
